item.title: Too Cold to Ski: Bone-Chilling Cold Warnings Sweep the Country, Lows Nearing -50 C
item.description: A baleful front of face-freezing Arctic air delivered a winter wallop across Canada’s midsection Friday, making it too cold to ski in parts of Manitoba.

item.title: Global Artists Bring New Warming Huts to Life at The Forks
item.description: WINNIPEG -- The artists have been chosen, and the designs have been finalized. The annual warming design competition is underway at The Forks.

item.title: Former Winnipeg Police Officer Sentenced to Seven Years in Prison
item.description: A former Winnipeg police officer has been sentenced to seven years in prison for selling drugs to colleagues and distributing a photo of a partially clothed deceased woman.

item.title: Manitoba Convenes U.S. Trade Council Ahead of CUSMA Negotiations
item.description: The Manitoba government is bringing together its U.S. Trade Council ahead of upcoming Canada–United States–Mexico Agreement negotiations.

item.title: Firefighters Extinguish Blaze in Winnipeg’s North End
item.description: Winnipeg firefighters battled a blaze in the North End early Saturday, when they were called to a vacant house in the 400 block of Flora Ave.

item.title: Suspect Sought After Armed Robbery of Winnipeg Taxi Driver
item.description: Winnipeg police are searching for a suspect after a taxi driver was robbed at gunpoint early Thursday in the William Whyte neighbourhood.

item.title: Jets ‘Embarrassed’ with Effort in 5-1 Loss to Visiting Red Wings
item.description: J.T. Compher scored twice as the Detroit Red Wings defeated the Winnipeg Jets 5-1 in front of a sold-out crowd at Canada Life Centre Saturday night.

item.title: Affordability, Sovereignty Expected to Dominate Debate as Parliamentarians Return
item.description: The struggle of Canadian families to make ends meet in a turbulent economy is expected to be a key theme as Parliament reconvenes after the holiday break.

item.title: Blue Bombers Re-Sign Veteran Tackle Stanley Bryant for 2026 Season
item.description: The Winnipeg Blue Bombers have re-signed star left tackle Stanley Bryant to a one-year contract for the 2026 season.

item.title: Construction to Begin on Four New Schools in Manitoba
item.description: Construction is getting underway on three new schools in Winnipeg, with site development also beginning in Brandon, the province announced on Monday.
